purpose: Check whether the 2018 BFAR NIFEP target called Piat Lake can be identified with the natural Mapannao Lake listed by NCCA, and look for fish evidence that is explicitly site-specific.

programLead.name: Piat Lake
programLead.reportedStatus: 2018 target for enhancement/restoration; the report does not verify completion

candidateWaterbodyCrosswalk.name: Mapannao Lake / Lawa ng Mapannao
candidateWaterbodyCrosswalk.metricsCaveat: The NCCA database entry gives these values but does not state their measurement method or provide a dated survey, coordinates or a lake polygon; they are recorded here as source-reported context only.
candidateWaterbodyCrosswalk.relationshipToNifepPiatLake: unresolved; the NIFEP report gives only Piat municipality and does not name Mapannao or Sto. Domingo

candidateWaterbodyCrosswalk.name: Proposed man-made lake for boating at CSU Piat Campus
candidateWaterbodyCrosswalk.reportedStatus: listed as a procurement-plan project; construction or completion was not verified
candidateWaterbodyCrosswalk.relationshipToNifepPiatLake: unresolved; the procurement entry does not connect this planned facility to the BFAR NIFEP target

officialRepositorySearches.scope: NFRDI repository, BFAR Region II and SEAFDEC indexed pages
officialRepositorySearches.result: No site-specific fish survey or checklist was retrieved in these bounded searches.
officialRepositorySearches.interpretation: Retrieval gap only; it does not establish that no survey or fish records exist.

fishNameVariantQueries.scopeLimit: Only indexed GBIF waterBody/locality text matching these values and the specified CoL XR Actinopterygii selection was checked. This excludes unindexed/missing locality values, other spellings and taxa outside the selected taxon.
fishNameVariantQueries.interpretation: Zero indexed matches are not evidence of fish absence or survey absence.

identityDecision.reason: The NIFEP source names only Piat municipality, while NCCA separately identifies Mapannao Lake in Sto. Domingo and a CSU Piat procurement plan lists a proposed man-made boating lake. Neither source links its site to the NIFEP target.

limits: The BFAR NIFEP report is a program and target-site source, not a Piat Lake fish checklist; its general discussion of tilapia fingerling stocking is not assigned to this site.
The NCCA Mapannao entry establishes a separately named natural-lake lead in Piat but does not establish it is the NIFEP Piat Lake, nor provide a reusable boundary or fish taxa.
The CSU procurement plan lists a proposed man-made boating lake but does not verify construction, location geometry or a connection to NIFEP.
Bounded indexed searches do not establish absence of fish, species surveys, or other records.
nextAction: Ask for or locate a site map/project completion record that identifies the BFAR NIFEP Piat Lake, then seek a dated fish assessment with methods, taxonomic determinations and vouchers. Do not merge Mapannao or the proposed CSU campus lake into the NIFEP waterbody without a direct crosswalk.
